## Summary

[Partial] Remove the lower ball joint from the knuckle and inspect the old LCA for subtle bends. [t811]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the lower ball joint from the knuckle, potentially using a chisel and bottle jack under the knuckle if resistance is high.
2. [Partial] Inspect the old LCA against the new one to identify any subtle bends or alignment issues not visible at first glance.
